import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 2

def design(feats):
    # Calculate effect sizes for all features
    effects = []
    for fid in feats.ids:
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        y1 = feats.x[feats.y==1, idx]
        y0 = feats.x[feats.y==0, idx]
        mean_diff = np.mean(y1) - np.mean(y0)
        t_stat = stats.ttest_ind(y1, y0).statistic
        effects.append((fid, abs(mean_diff), abs(t_stat)))
    
    # Sort by effect size (t-statistic)
    effects.sort(key=lambda x: x[2], reverse=True)
    
    # Select top drivers (at most MAX_DRIVERS)
    drivers = [fid for fid, _, _ in effects[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # Include only top 3 features for logistic regression to keep model small
    columns = [fid for fid, _, _ in effects[:3]]
    
    # No interaction terms to keep model small
    products = ()
    
    # Create weighted score from top features
    loadings = {}
    for i, (fid, _, _) in enumerate(effects[:3]):
        # Weight by effect size
        loadings[fid] = effects[i][1] / max([e[1] for e in effects]) if effects else 1
    
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(drivers),
        columns=tuple(columns),
        products=products,
        loadings=loadings
    )
